name: HelpCenter
task: Website or Shopify chat & FAQ deflection
summary: Shopify helpdesk with live chat and an AI FAQ builder: email, chat and Messenger in one ticket queue, plus SEO-friendly FAQ pages.
best_for: small Shopify stores that want ticketing, live chat and a searchable FAQ page from one app rather than bolting three together
skip_if: you already run a general helpdesk like Zendesk or Freshdesk for a business wider than the store: this is Shopify-shaped, not company-shaped
honest_knock: The free tier is the hook and the FAQ builder is the reason people stay. But the meter is tickets, not agents, and since the ladder changed there is no small paid tier any more: the first step up from Free is Standard at $40 a month. Free charges $0.25 for every ticket past ten, so a store doing around 170 tickets a month pays as much in overage as Standard costs. One dependency worth knowing: translating FAQs into many languages is handed off to a separate app (LangShop), so a multilingual store can end up with two subscriptions.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Standard · per month, or $400 a year
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-11-01 and again, unchanged, on 2026-11-12 on apps.shopify.com/helpcenter) Free to install, and the meter is tickets rather than agents. The plan ladder changed since our earlier reading: the small Basic tier is gone, so the first paid step is now Standard. Free covers 10 tickets a month and charges $0.25 for each one after that. Standard is $40 a month or $400 a year (the listing says this saves 17%) for 500 tickets, then $0.15 each, with unlimited seats. Advanced is $70 or $700 a year for 1,000 tickets, then $0.12. Enterprise is $120 or $1,200 a year for 2,000 tickets, then $0.10 per ticket (the listing prints it as “0.1 per ticket”), and adds a dedicated account manager. Every paid tier carries a 14-day free trial and all charges are billed in USD. Which means the jump from free to paid is now $0 to $40: on Free, 170 tickets a month cost $40 in overage, so below that volume staying on Free is cheaper than Standard. The App Store lists it as “SB: Helpdesk, Live Chat & FAQs” from Shark Byte, Inc — the product calls itself HelpCenter, so you will see both names. Rating 4.6 from 318 reviews on 1 November and again on 12 November 2026. Not on the listing: HelpCenter's own pricing page (helpcenterapp.com/pricing, read 12 November 2026) also sells an Unlimited plan at $200 a month, or $1,999.92 billed annually, with unlimited tickets.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested HelpCenter on a Shopify development store: the install, an onboarding, the Free plan with 10 tickets and a FAQ limit of 5 articles, and two FAQ questions saved in the app. We did not see the FAQ page in the web shop: the checklist item and the preview did not open anything, and the theme editor has embeds only for a contact form, live chat, tabs and a widget. The plan page showed Standard $40, Advanced $70 and Enterprise $120 a month (500, 1000 and 2000 tickets) and, on the yearly view, $33.33, $58.33 and $100 a month, without a price per extra ticket. No paid plan was started, so nothing was approved, and the app was uninstalled afterwards. Install: the install form of the App Store listing (English) was submitted in our own tab at 18:49; the Shopify dialog asked for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data; Install was clicked at about 18:50 and the app was open at about 18:51. In the admin the app is called SB: FAQ | HelpCenter (Shark Byte, Inc). The onboarding was Thank you for installing Helpcenter!, Continue, Unlock AI Content Generation and Later. No password, card, phone number or sign-up form of the vendor was asked. The admin was in English. Plan choice: Free was chosen with Get started at about 18:52, free and with no card. The Helpdesk tab said My plan: Free, Tickets: 10, Monthly ticket limit 0/10 (0%) and Top-ups are only available on paid plans, and asked to Create account for the helpdesk (not done). The FAQ Page tab said My plan: Free and FAQ: Up to 5 articles; the template Minimalistic was already Active, and the example categories Orders (Tracking, Shipping) and Exchange & Returns were there, switched off. Core action, a FAQ page with two test questions: the articles How long does shipping take? and What is your return policy? were made in Orders, Tracking, with the message Article saved! (about 18:57 and 18:59). Each article took 3 steps (the question, the answer in the text editor, Save); the slug field filled itself. New articles were switched on by default and the example article How to track my order? stayed off. In all 3 articles of the 5 allowed on Free were in the app. From the install click (about 18:50) to the second saved question (about 18:59) it took about 9 minutes, including the onboarding and the plan choice. The FAQ page in the web shop was NOT seen: the checklist item Add FAQ page to your store did not react to a click; Preview in Customize FAQ template opened nothing in our tab; in the theme editor, App embeds, HelpCenter has only Contact form, Live Chat, Tabs and Widget (all off) and no embed for a FAQ page. The Widget was switched on in the preview, showed no visible result on the home page, and was switched off again; the editor was left with Leave page and nothing was saved. So the two questions were saved in the app (yes), but that they show in the web shop is not proven, and no route to the FAQ page was found without a theme change. Plans in the app, monthly view: Standard $40/month (14-Day Free Trial; Knowledge Base 100 Articles; FAQ translations up to 5; AI-generated FAQs; unlimited seats; CRM with 500 tickets/mo), Advanced $70/month (14-Day Free Trial; All from Standard; unlimited articles and translations; premium templates; CRM with 1000 tickets/mo) and Enterprise $120/month (All from Advanced; prioritized support; performance report; CRM with 2000 tickets/mo); under them the Free plan: No AI integrations, Limited FAQ articles, Default FAQ designs, Knowledge Base: Up to 10 Articles. Annual view (Annual (save 2 months)): Standard $33.33/month, Advanced $58.33/month and Enterprise $100/month, with CRM 6000 tickets/yr, 12000 and 24000. Difference with the listing and the dossier: the listing says save 17% and names the price per extra ticket ($0.25, $0.15, $0.12); the app did not show a price per extra ticket on the plan cards. The plan prices and ticket limits in the app are the same as in the dossier; the Free plan limit of FAQ: Up to 5 articles was seen in the app. Checkout: NOT reached. Only the Free plan was chosen; no paid plan was started, so no Shopify approval screen, no trial and no test charge was seen. Cancelling: no plan was paid, so nothing could be cancelled. The uninstall route is Settings, Apps, the menu of the app, Uninstall; the dialog says a request will be sent to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information, and a reason for uninstalling is required (Testing multiple apps). Not tested: paid plans, the trial, the Helpdesk account (Create account), live chat, the e-mail channel, Messenger, AI generation, translations, Product Tabs, Contact Form and the FAQ page in the web shop. Clean up: the app was uninstalled at about 19:03 with the message that it was uninstalled; nothing was saved or left in the live theme (the Widget switch was not saved); our own tab was closed. The clock times in the notes can be a few minutes off. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The FAQ page in the web shop could not be reached: the checklist item Add FAQ page to your store did not react, Preview opened nothing, and the theme editor has no FAQ page embed; the plan cards show no price per extra ticket; and the Free plan limits the FAQ to 5 articles.
